To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we propose a novel imitation learning method that learns to imitate a task by observing a demonstration from a first person perspective and a second person perspective.
we have proposed and demonstrated the first deep learning method to learn imitation from raw perception, which is able to learn complex manipulation skills from demonstrations of others.

1) people can learn complex tasks by observing others perform the tasks, 2) they do so without access to the demonstrations, and 3) they do so by observing the raw perceptions of others, not by accessing the abstracted demonstration.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the problem of visual imitation learning.
understanding and reproducing these skills.
how people learn to imitate, what they are learning, and how we might use these insights to develop new learning algorithms for robots.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

people are able to learn to imitate from observing others, even when there are significant morphological differences between the imitator and the demonstrator, and even when the imitator has partial state information.
visual imitation learning is a very complex task.
the ability to imitate others is a fundamental part of human nature and is a critical part of the human learning process.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we aim to solve the problem of learning from raw visual observations by developing a recurrent siamese network.
we are trying to build a system which is able to do this.
we have developed a new imitation learning framework that can solve this problem in a way similar to how people learn.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we can learn to solve complex tasks by observing the actions of others.
the same problem can be solved in an intelligent agent by learning to predict the future of an observed demonstration, and then using that predicted future to guide the agent’s own action policy.
we can learn how to imitate others in a similar manner.
